gameVerifiedNote: Metadata only: the interop members below were read from the Forge-MapEditor-QA profile's Modules-ASM.dll (ilspycmd, read-only). The value shape is cited from GTFO-API's own printouts already present in this machine's game logs; this task started no game, installed nothing and ran no level. What the matcher compares is the rundown block and the expedition's tier and index, never the game's key string, so the log citation is corroboration of the same reading rather than a comparison input.

rules: all three segments are decimal without leading zeros; tier is one uppercase letter from A to E
the rundown block id is the plan package's target block persistentID (the authoring side writes 31)
the tier index is the level's zero-based position inside its tier's exported level list
a reference that is not this shape names no level and is refused with one bounded diagnostic, never matched loosely

the game's own tier ordinal (TierA=1 … TierE=5, Surface=99); a value outside the five letters names no level this vocabulary can spell and is refused
the zero-based position of the level inside its tier
the key the game builds for the same expedition (`Local_31_TierA_0`)
